summary: Localized editorial status: draft, published, scheduled or archived, built on Badge.
whenToUse: Showing the actual status returned by the backend.
whenNotToUse: Showing a save still in progress as published.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the default label, for example with the publication date.

props.name: variant / size / dot
props.description: Badge appearance; the tone depends on the status.

inherits: Badge HTML props, className, style and an HTMLSpanElement ref. tone is assigned semantically.
accessibility: Status is expressed as text, not just color.
No automatic live region; for important updates use a role=status container.
responsive: The badge follows its content and allows long labels.
commonMistakes: Confusing the badge display with an actually persisted workflow.
limits: Does not schedule, publish or archive content; performs no authorization checks.
